method: Opened each original generated PNG with view_image after renderer actual exit 0; compared plotted points with saved ADDITIONAL_JVP.csv.
observations: 90 mm and 180 mm versions have readable axes, all four series in a two-row legend, no clipped labels or legend/axis collisions.
Near-coincident values overlap at y2, and hires values nearly overlap at y4; these match the CSV and distinct markers/line styles identify the series.
Y axis is linear with an explicit zero origin and 1e-17 multiplier; no positive display floor. All 16 recorded values in this run are positive.
These are binary64 directional error diagnostics, not 80-digit implementation accuracy, grid convergence, or physical time evolution.
